objects.name: The Vinegar Lamp
objects.vInscr: They washed the step with vinegar every morning. The sickness came in anyway.

landmarks.name: The Paid Witness
landmarks.inscription: Its priests put out its eyes so it could not see what was done in its name, and paid it for the loss. It is still holding out its hands.

landmarks.name: The Font of the Unsaid Mother
landmarks.inscription: Her priests drained themselves into it one by one, and still it is not full. Kneel, and it will take a little of you too.
